items.title: Aicpm – Verifiable AI provenance labels for web content
items.raw_excerpt:
AICPM (Authenticated AI Content Provenance Marking) is an open, provable way to label AI-generated text inside documents using signed chunk-level provenance. Many current approaches (watermarks, detectors, platform labels) are brittle, unverifiable, or proprietary. AICPM uses provider-signed manifests and offline verifiers to produce transparency without central control or guessing. Features:
- Provider-signed chunk provenance with signatures
- Deterministic verification (offline, browser-native)
- Test vectors + reference verifier included
- Browser extension shows “AI %”, verified/edited breakdown

items.title: 首个多模态记忆湖MemoryLake发布：AI基础设施迈入记忆驱动时代

items.raw_excerpt: It's 2026 and we're still raw-dogging 10,000 lines of Vulkan to draw a triangle, or using high-level libraries that don't even have basic transient buffer allocation or caching. Most high-level gfx APIs don't even get the basics right. Transient staging, sync, cached FBOs/PSOs/descriptor sets, RT support. Instead they enforce invented concepts onto a rock (the GPU), which does not really care how elegant your invented abstraction is. Or they take a "common denominator features of 2006" approach, ending up extremely outdated in 2026. Great if you plan on running your cutting edge graphics project on a knockoff MediaTek phone running Android Kit Kat and about nothing else. So I wrote one with AI as a statement: someone please write one by hand that's better, not worse.

excerpt_i18n.en:
On February 9, Baidu Intelligent Cloud officially launched the OpenClaw Rapid and Easy Deployment Solution. Developers can log in to the Baidu Intelligent Cloud official website and use the lightweight application server's visual configuration panel to easily deploy OpenClaw, accelerating the transition of Agent applications from trial to practical use.

OpenClaw is an open-source AI Agent project that has quickly gained popularity in the global developer community, often referred to as a "digital employee that can command a computer." It leverages large model capabilities and automates local environment and task processes through mechanisms such as file read/write, terminal execution, memory management, and multi-agent collaboration. However, for many non-professional developers, complex environment setup and model integration remain significant barriers.

The new easy deployment solution from Baidu Intelligent Cloud primarily addresses the "difficult deployment" issue. Developers need only select the pre-configured OpenClow image on the lightweight application server, and the system will automatically complete environment installation and service startup without manual dependency configuration. For model integration, developers can simply choose the required model from a dropdown menu, and the platform will automatically create and configure the Qianfan API Key within the instance.

In practice, the solution consolidates previously scattered processes such as model integration, message platform configuration, and skill loading into visual steps, supporting on-demand activation of Lark, DingTalk, and WeChat Work.

El 9 de febrero, Baidu Intelligent Cloud lanzó oficialmente la versión rápida y sencilla de implementación de OpenClaw. Los desarrolladores pueden acceder al sitio web oficial de Baidu Intelligent Cloud y utilizar el panel de configuración visual del servidor de aplicaciones ligero para implementar fácilmente OpenClaw, acelerando así el proceso de llevar las aplicaciones de Agent de la etapa de prueba a la práctica.

OpenClaw es un proyecto de código abierto de AI Agent que ha ganado popularidad rápidamente en la comunidad de desarrolladores globales y que muchos usuarios llaman "el empleado digital que puede dirigir una computadora". Puede aprovechar las capacidades de grandes modelos y realizar funciones como lectura y escritura de archivos, ejecución en el terminal, gestión de memoria y colaboración entre múltiples agentes.

items.title: 中美AI应用的分岔路，出现在这个春节
items.raw_excerpt: 距离春节还有十天，AI大战提前进入了白热化。 而这次把战场迅速烧热的，是阿里的 AI 入口“千问”。 2月6日，千问上线“春节30亿大免单”活动，机制简单粗暴——请全国人民喝奶茶。活动期间，用户最高可领取21张、总价值525元的无门槛免单卡。 这绝非又一场“外卖大战”，而是一场 AI 办事能力的“大考”。当成千上万的用户涌进 AI 产品，让最先进的人工智能与最落地的烟火气相遇。 Agent 时代下，每个人的生活决策已经可以交由 AI 完成。硅谷巨头们正竞相构建面向企业系统的“数字员工”，试图让 AI 接管办公流中的繁琐环节；而在中国，Agent 的落点则更早地切入了充满烟火气的现实世界，开始替人点一杯奶茶、订一张车票。 这并非技术能力的代差，而是基于土壤不同的路径选择。 而千问，似乎要在帮人办事这条道路上，走得更深更远。 01 重新定义AI时代的抢红包 2026年春节前夕，AI战场的硝烟味比往年更甚。 字节的“豆包”依托春晚的独家赞助，试图用AI生成内容延续短视频时代的流量法则；腾讯的“元宝”则背靠微信生态，试图在社交连接中寻找AI的落点；百度依然固守搜索与信息分发阵地。 这三者的共同点在于，它们争夺的依然是用户的“注意力时长”。 其本质延续了移动互联网时代的经典公式：用更优质的内容或更顺滑的交互，去争夺用户有限的时间与多巴胺，让用户愿意在App里多停留一分钟。 相比之下，千问选择了一条更为艰难、也更为彻底的路径。 与其继续在红海中争夺“用户停留多久”，千问更在意的是：用户是否愿意把真实生活中的决策与执行，交给AI。 因此，千问并未沿用传统的现金红包，而是选择以“免单”切入春节场景。免单无法独立存在，它必须嵌入真实的消费决策与完整的服务链路之中——用户需要

excerpt_i18n.es: A diez días de la Fiesta de Primavera, la batalla de IA ha entrado en su fase más intensa. El que ha encendido rápidamente el campo de batalla es el acceso de IA de Alibaba, "Qwen". Esto no es otra guerra de entrega a domicilio, sino una gran prueba de las capacidades prácticas de la IA. excerpt_i18n.en:
Ten days before the Spring Festival, the AI battle has already heated up. Leading this rapid escalation is Alibaba's AI platform, Qwen. On February 6th, Qwen launched a "3 Billion Free for Spring Festival" campaign with a straightforward mechanism—treating the nation to milk tea. During the event, users can receive up to 21 vouchers worth a total of 525 yuan, usable without any spending threshold. This is not just another food delivery competition but a significant test of AI's practical capabilities. As millions of users flood into AI products, the most advanced artificial intelligence meets the down-to-earth needs of everyday life. In the Agent era, people can entrust their daily decisions to AI. Silicon Valley giants are competing to build "digital employees" for enterprise systems, aiming to streamline office workflows with AI. In China, however, Agents have more quickly integrated into the real world, starting to order a cup of milk tea or book a train ticket for users. This is not a difference in technical capability but a choice based on different environments. Qwen seems determined to delve deeper into the realm of helping people with their daily tasks.

On February 6, 2026, Ren Xiaoyu, founder and CEO of Dongyi Technology, officially announced the establishment of the company's manufacturing center in Guangzhou at a launch event held in the Haizhu Creative Industry Park. The decision to locate the manufacturing center in Guangzhou was a strategic choice based on multiple considerations. Guangzhou not only aligns with the two major industrial initiatives of Guangdong Province but also boasts a highly concentrated robotics and artificial intelligence industry ecosystem. This enables efficient conversion of research and development outcomes from concept to product, significantly reducing mass production trial costs, and perfectly meets the critical needs of enterprises transitioning from innovative technology to industrialization.

The launch event featured several highlights, including the layout of the manufacturing center and the announcement of the mass production of Dongyi Technology's embodied intelligent agent, PHYBOT C2 (hereinafter referred to as C2). Additionally, the core motion control intelligent agent PhyCore 0.1 was made globally and permanently open-source.

Founded in September 2024, Dongyi Technology has had a core vision of "Robot for AI" since its inception, focusing on the development of next-generation general-purpose embodied intelligent agents. They aim to address a fundamental question in the AGI era: when artificial intelligence possesses excellent cognitive and thinking abilities, what kind of "body" should be equipped to genuinely perceive and alter the physical world?

C2 Mass Production Launch: A Warm and Intelligent Server

The highlight of the launch event was the official mass production of Dongyi Technology's embodied intelligent agent, C2, which showcases the company's hardware capabilities. C2 has a payload capacity of 5KG.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 6 de febrero de 2026, Ren Xiaoyu, fundador y CEO de Dongyi Technology, anunció oficialmente en una conferencia de prensa celebrada en el Parque Industrial de Creatividad de Haizhu, Guangzhou, que el centro de fabricación inteligente de la empresa se establecería en Guangzhou. Esta decisión estratégica de establecer el centro en Guangzhou se tomó tras múltiples consideraciones. Guangzhou no solo sigue las dos principales iniciativas industriales de la provincia de Guangdong, sino que también cuenta con un ecosistema altamente concentrado de robótica y tecnología de inteligencia artificial, lo que permite una conversión eficiente de los resultados de investigación de los planos a productos físicos, reduciendo significativamente los costos de prueba en producción a gran escala y adaptándose perfectamente a las necesidades cruciales de la empresa en su etapa de transición de innovación tecnológica a industrialización. La conferencia de prensa estuvo llena de puntos destacados, incluyendo el anuncio del centro de fabricación inteligente y la presentación del robot físico PHYBOT de Dongyi Technology.
